FAQ

Questions? Answered

Is YouTube Music sign-in safe?

Yes. You sign in through Google’s official page. Sonify does not ask for your password on its own screen.

Do I need a Sonify account?

No. YouTube Music sign-in is optional for likes and playlists.

Is Sonify ad-free and private?

Yes. No tracking for ads — just download, install, and play.

Where do I download?

Use any Download button here for the official Sonify V5.2 APK.

How do I install?

Open the APK, allow the source if prompted, then tap Install.

YouTube Music

Sign in the right way

Optional. Use Google’s official sign-in to bring likes and playlists into Sonify — Sonify never asks for your password on its own screen.

1
Open profile

Tap your avatar / account area in the app.

2
Choose Google

Continue with Google / YouTube Music on the secure Google page.

3
Allow access

Confirm the permissions Google shows.

4
See your music

Liked songs and playlists appear in Library.

No Sonify account is required. Sign-in is only for importing your YouTube Music data.
